economicMission.title: Economic Mission & Objectives
economicMission.description: Directs Gemini to optimize total impressions won across the 24-hour flight while pacing budget expenditure evenly to avoid running out before primetime.

firstPriceGuidance.title: First-Price Auction Guidance
firstPriceGuidance.description: Explicitly instructs the agent to shade bids near competitor market prices rather than bidding fixed ceilings, mitigating the Overpayment Trap.

toolingProtocol.title: Autonomous Tooling Protocol
toolingProtocol.description: Guides the agent on how to call get_campaign_info() for boundaries, ask_data_agent() for BigQuery telemetry percentiles, and deploy_bidding_policy() to publish Python code.

interfaceContract.title: Python Interface Contract
interfaceContract.description: Strictly defines the expected compute_bid(context: AuctionContext) signature and documents all injected runtime attributes (p90, daypart, budget, hours).

adServerFetch.title: Ad Server REST Fetch
adServerFetch.description: Queries the /campaign/config endpoint to read live parameters including the $2,500 total budget and 24-hour flight window.

pydanticValidation.title: Pydantic Model Validation
pydanticValidation.description: Validates JSON responses against strict CampaignInfo schema to prevent runtime attribute errors.

adcAuth.title: GCP ADC Authentication
adcAuth.description: Obtains secure Google Cloud OAuth2 tokens via Application Default Credentials (ADC).

dataAgentToolset.title: Native DataAgentToolset
dataAgentToolset.description: Binds to the Gemini Data Analytics service, equipping the native ask_data_agent tool for natural language analytics.

preflight.title: Level 1: Pre-Flight Self-Evaluation
preflight.description: Performs deterministic AST syntax verification and a runtime smoke test with AuctionContext before saving, rejecting broken code back to the agent.

pep8.title: PEP 8 Auto-Formatting
pep8.description: Auto-formats synthesized Python code via Black and wraps lines for production consistency.

atomicDeploy.title: Atomic Disk Deployment
atomicDeploy.description: Writes the verified code atomically to agent_bidding_policy.py where the ad simulator dynamically hot-reloads it.

pacing.label: 1. Dynamic Pacing
pacing.title: Burn Rate Velocity
pacing.body: Balances spend speed against remaining flight time so the budget lasts without under-spending.

shading.label: 2. Daypart Shading
shading.title: Time-of-Day Shading
shading.body: Shades bids lower in off-peak late night to conserve cash, bidding aggressively in primetime.

microSignals.label: 3. Micro-Signals
microSignals.title: Momentum & Win Rate
microSignals.body: Detects competitor price surges across recent history and boosts bids if win rates dip.

clamping.label: 4. Safety Clamping
clamping.title: Ceiling & Floor Limits
clamping.body: Strictly enforces the maximum bid ceiling and minimum floor to prevent runaway auction costs.
